.nav-link[aria-current="page"] { color: var(--text-primary); background: rgba(194, 65, 12, 0.13); border-color: rgba(194, 65, 12, 0.42); }
.sidebar-footer { border-top: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); gap: 16px; margin-top: auto; padding-top: 16px; display: grid; }
.sidebar-context { color: var(--text-muted); align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-size: 12px; display: flex; }

.logout-link { border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); min-height: 44px; color: var(--text-secondary); border-radius: 12px; justify-content: center; align-items: center; gap: 8px; transition: color 0.16s, background-color 0.16s, border-color 0.16s; display: inline-flex; }
.logout-link:hover { border-color: var(--border-strong); background: var(--elevated); color: var(--text-primary); }

.mobile-topbar { z-index: 35; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); background: var(--surface); justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; height: 64px; padding: 8px 16px; display: none; position: sticky; top: 0px; }
.mobile-menu-backdrop { z-index: 60; background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.64); justify-content: flex-end; display: none; position: fixed; inset: 0px; }
.mobile-menu { border-left: 1px solid var(--border-strong); background: var(--surface); flex-direction: column; width: min(88vw, 360px); height: 100%; padding: 24px 16px; display: flex; }
.mobile-menu__header { justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 16px; display: flex; }
.app-main { isolation: isolate; min-height: 100vh; margin-left: 240px; position: relative; }
.app-main::before { z-index: -1; content: ""; pointer-events: none; background: url("/operational-grid.svg"); height: 448px; position: absolute; inset: 0px 0px auto; }
.page-header { justify-content: space-between; align-items: flex-end; gap: 24px; display: flex; }
.page-header h1 { color: var(--text-primary); letter-spacing: -0.02em; margin: 4px 0px 0px; font-size: 28px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.2; }
.eyebrow { color: var(--text-muted); letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; margin: 0px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.4; }
.surface-card { border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); background: var(--surface); box-shadow: none; border-radius: 16px; padding: 24px; }
.surface-card__header { justify-content: space-between; align-items: flex-start; gap: 16px; margin-bottom: 24px; display: flex; }
.surface-card__header h2, .section-heading { color: var(--text-primary); margin: 0px; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.25; }
.health-anchor__content { grid-template-columns: 48px minmax(0px, 1fr) auto; align-items: center; gap: 16px; display: grid; }
.health-anchor__icon { background: var(--elevated); width: 48px; height: 48px; color: var(--text-muted); border-radius: 12px; place-items: center; display: grid; }

.ui-button { cursor: pointer; border: 1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); border-radius: 12px; justify-content: center; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 44px; padding: 8px 16px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.25; transition: color 0.16s, background-color 0.16s, border-color 0.16s, opacity 0.16s; display: inline-flex; }
.ui-button--secondary { border-color: var(--border-subtle); background: var(--surface); color: var(--text-primary); }
.ui-button--destructive { color: var(--error); background: rgba(225, 29, 72, 0.15); border-color: rgba(225, 29, 72, 0.44); }
.metric-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0px, 1fr)); gap: 16px; display: grid; }
.metric-card { border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); background: var(--surface); border-radius: 16px; min-width: 0px; padding: 24px; }
.metric-card__label { color: var(--text-muted); letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; }
.metric-card__value { color: var(--text-primary); text-overflow: ellipsis; margin-top: 8px; font-size: 28px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.2; display: block; overflow: hidden; }
.metric-card__qualifier { color: var(--text-muted); margin-top: 4px; font-size: 12px; display: block; }

.status-badge { border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); min-height: 28px; color: var(--text-secondary); white-space: nowrap; border-radius: 999px; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 4px 8px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; display: inline-flex; }
.status-badge::before { content: ""; background: currentcolor; border-radius: 50%; width: 7px; height: 7px; }
.status-badge--success { color: var(--success); background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.12); border-color: rgba(110, 231, 183, 0.28); }
.status-badge--warning { color: var(--warning); background: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.12); border-color: rgba(252, 211, 77, 0.28); }
.status-badge--error { color: var(--error); background: rgba(225, 29, 72, 0.13); border-color: rgba(253, 164, 175, 0.28); }
.status-badge--info { color: var(--info); background: rgba(14, 165, 233, 0.11); border-color: rgba(125, 211, 252, 0.28); }

.state-panel { border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); background: var(--surface); border-radius: 16px; grid-template-columns: 24px minmax(0px, 1fr) auto; align-items: start; gap: 16px; min-height: 104px; padding: 24px; display: grid; }
.state-panel--error { color: var(--error); background: rgba(225, 29, 72, 0.08); border-color: rgba(253, 164, 175, 0.32); }
.state-panel--warning { color: var(--warning); background: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.07); border-color: rgba(252, 211, 77, 0.28); }
.state-panel--success { color: var(--success); background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.07); border-color: rgba(110, 231, 183, 0.28); }
.state-panel--loading > svg { animation: 1s linear 0s infinite normal none running loading-spin; }
.info-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0px, 1fr)); gap: 24px; display: grid; }

rules: body { font-family: Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif; background: rgb(24, 25, 27); color: rgb(248, 250, 252); display: flex; min-height: 100vh; align-items: center; justify-content: center; margin: 0px; padding: 24px; }
.card { width: min(448px, 100%); background: rgb(23, 27, 34); border: 1px solid rgb(37, 48, 61); border-radius: 12px; padding: 28px 24px; }
.brand-mark { display: block; width: 72px; height: 72px; margin: 0px auto 6px; }
.dest { margin-top: 28px; padding: 14px 16px; border-radius: 12px; background: rgb(27, 34, 44); border: 1px solid rgb(37, 48, 61); }
.dest small { display: block; color: rgb(167, 176, 170); font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; margin-bottom: 8px; }
.dest-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-weight: 600; }
.shield { width: 18px; height: 18px; color: rgb(255, 113, 18); flex: 0 0 auto; }
.field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 9px; margin-top: 18px; }
.icon-left, .icon-right { position: absolute; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%); color: rgb(148, 163, 184); line-height: 1; }
input { width: 100%; height: 44px; border-radius: 11px; border: 1px solid rgb(64, 83, 107); background: rgb(30, 42, 57); color: rgb(255, 255, 255); padding: 0px 42px; font-size: 14px; }

button { height: 44px; border-width: medium; border-style: none; border-color: currentcolor; border-image: none; border-radius: 11px; background: rgb(255, 113, 18); color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-weight: 700; width: 100%; margin-top: 18px; font-size: 14px; }
.error { margin: 18px 0px 0px; padding: 12px; border: 1px solid rgb(127, 29, 29); background: rgb(69, 10, 10); border-radius: 12px; color: rgb(254, 202, 202); }
